summary: Finds nearest or connected neighboring points using P, writes neighbor index arrays such as Nebr and counts such as NumNebrs, and can also output averages, inverse-distance weighted averages, distances, hash debug attributes, or neighbor attributes.

key_params.name: nebrtype
key_params.note: Find neighbors by distance or by connectivity

key_params.name: distribution
key_params.note: Default, unique, or closest neighbor selection

key_params.name: numhashbuckets
key_params.note: Spatial hash bucket count; often close to point count

key_params.name: outputhash
key_params.note: Outputs spatial hash values for debugging and tuning

key_params.name: nebroutput
key_params.note: Output neighbor arrays, average, or inverse-distance weighted average

key_params.name: maxneighbors
key_params.note: Array size for per-point neighbor outputs

key_params.name: maxnebrsavg
key_params.note: Maximum neighbors considered for average outputs

key_params.name: incquerypt
key_params.note: Include the query point when averaging

key_params.name: addprefix
key_params.note: Add Nebr prefix to neighbor attributes

key_params.name: castintstofloats
key_params.note: Cast integer attributes to floats for averaging

key_params.name: nebrptattrs
key_params.note: Neighbor point attributes to output as arrays

key_concepts: Neighbor POP uses P to find nearby points and can write neighbor index arrays, counts, distances, averages, or neighbor attribute arrays.
By Distance mode uses Max Neighbors Distance and spatial hashing; Connected mode uses one-step primitive edge connectivity.
The Nebr array has fixed size Max Neighbors, and missing entries use the uint sentinel 4294967295.
A second input can be used as the neighbor search set, comparing first-input query points against second-input points.
Output modes can produce raw neighbor indexes, average values, or inverse-distance weighted averages; Include Query Point changes average behavior.
Neighbor attribute output can create large array attributes, so planners should scope attributes and Max Neighbors deliberately.
common_gotchas: Missing neighbors are represented with the uint sentinel 4294967295 in the neighbor index array.
maxneighbors fixes the array size; tune it before GLSL code indexes Nebr.
Outputting neighbor attributes can create large array data quickly, so scope only the attributes needed.
